files.context: This is a photo a customer attached to a support ticket. It shows a dark panel with coloured squares, and the customer outlined one square in green because it does not respond. Describe what you see and which square the customer is pointing at.
This is a screenshot a customer sent of a screen that looks wrong to them. Describe the colours and shapes on it.
This is a short screen recording a customer sent. Describe what is shown and what changes during the clip.
This is a short video a customer recorded of a display. Describe the colours it shows, in order.
This is a short video a customer recorded of a display. Describe the background colour and what moves on it.
